items.docs: Submit a new signed transaction to the Arweave network. Transactions can transfer AR tokens, store data, or both. Use format=2 for v2 transactions which support large data via chunked uploads. The reward field must be in winstons obtained from the /price endpoint.

params.name: id
params.description: Transaction ID (Base64URL encoded SHA-256 of signature)

items.docs: Retrieve a full transaction object by its transaction ID. Returns 202 if the transaction is pending (not yet mined into a block).

params.name: id
params.description: Transaction ID (Base64URL encoded SHA-256 of signature)

items.docs: Returns the confirmation status of a transaction including the block height it was mined into, the block hash, and the number of confirmations.

params.name: id
params.description: Transaction ID (Base64URL encoded SHA-256 of signature)

items.docs: Fetch a single field from a transaction. Valid fields are: id, last_tx, owner, tags, target, quantity, data, data_root, data_size, reward, signature.

params.name: id
params.description: Transaction ID (Base64URL encoded SHA-256 of signature)

items.docs: Download the data payload associated with a transaction. Returns the Base64URL decoded data with the appropriate Content-Type header based on the transaction's Content-Type tag.

params.name: id
params.description: Transaction ID (Base64URL encoded SHA-256 of signature)

items.docs: Returns the byte offset of a transaction's data within the Arweave weave along with the data size. Used to retrieve specific chunks.

info.name: Get transaction data with MIME type hint

params.name: id
params.description: Transaction ID (Base64URL encoded SHA-256 of signature)

params.name: extension
params.description: File extension used to determine MIME type (e.g. html, txt, jpg, png, mp4)

items.docs: Download transaction data with the response Content-Type determined by the file extension. For example, /tx/{id}/data.html returns the data with Content-Type text/html.

info.name: Get decoded transaction data by ID

items.docs: Retrieve and return the decoded data payload for a transaction directly by its ID. This is a shorthand for /tx/{id}/data and sets the appropriate Content-Type header from the transaction's tags.

params.name: bytes
params.description: Size of data in bytes (use 0 for token-only transfers)

items.docs: Calculate the minimum fee in winstons required to store the specified number of bytes. Use bytes=0 to get the fee for a pure token transfer with no data.

params.name: bytes
params.description: Size of data in bytes (use 0 for token-only transfers)

items.docs: Calculate the minimum fee in winstons for storing the specified number of bytes and optionally sending to a target wallet address. An extra fee is included for the first transaction sent to a new wallet address.
